module: Editor helper for fuzzy search with "frecency" ranking (frequency/recency of use). The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/searchUtil')(). You call startSearch, queryElement for each candidate, then finishSearch which returns the results sorted by final score. Also provides an imgui combo with built-in search (beginSearchableSimpleCombo).
usage:
local s = require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/searchUtil')()
s:startSearch('veh')
for _, e in ipairs(liste) do s:queryElement({name = e, frecencyId = e}) end
local res = s:finishSearch()
notes: matchStringScore(name, match, ignoreEarly) is exposed as C.matchStringScore: score = matched characters / label length (up to 7 occurrences), blended 50% with an early-position bonus.
Frecency: 1/1.25^(elapsed days); the stored value is the os.time() of the last use. updateFrecencyEntry cancels the previous update if it is less than 10 s old.
beginSearchableSimpleCombo uses ffi.string without declaring ffi locally (depends on the global ffi); imgui is received as a parameter.

init.desc: Installs the default scoring and tie-breaking function (by name) and frecencyWeight = 0.5.

setScoringFunction.desc: Replaces the scoring function (element, match) -> number.

fun.desc: Returns a score; > 0 keeps the element.

setSameScoreResolvingFunction.desc: Replaces the tie-breaking function (a, b) -> boolean used when the final score is equal.

startSearch.desc: Starts a search: clears the results, remembers the searched string and forgets the frecency undo.

queryElement.desc: Evaluates an element: writes elem.score and adds it to the results if the score is > 0.

finishSearch.desc: Computes frecency and finalScore of each result, sorts (finalScore descending) and returns the list.

updateFrecencyEntry.desc: Marks an identifier as used now (os.time()). If the previous update is 10 s old or less, it is canceled first.

getFrecencyScore.desc: Recency score between 0 and 1 (0 if unknown).

beginSearchableSimpleCombo.desc: Draws an imgui combo with a search field, X button and filtered list (140 px high, UI-scaled). Returns the clicked element.

self.desc: Function fields set on the instance by init.

returns.desc: True if a comes before b.
